Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures - but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.

Role Summary
DWS is seeking a Director-level Enterprise Data Engineer with 18+ years of experience in data engineering, architecture, and enterprise platforms. Deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake implementation and a strong background in data modeling within asset management domain. The ideal candidate will have designed and implemented complex investment data models, especially on Aladdin (BlackRock), and will play a strategic role in shaping our enterprise data strategy while being actively involved in hands-on engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale data models in Snowflake to support investment data, portfolio analytics, risk, and performance workflows.
Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating Aladdin data, market/reference data providers, and internal financial systems.
Build investment data models such as:
Portfolio & Holdings Model (positions, transactions, performance)
Benchmark & Index Model (tracking error, benchmark alignment, relative performance)
Risk Model (VaR, factor exposures, scenario analysis)
Compliance & Regulatory Model (pre-trade/post-trade checks, regulatory filings, client mandates)
Performance Attribution Model (security-level attribution, multi-factor attribution)
Ensure data governance, lineage, and quality frameworks are built into the data layer.
Partner with principal engineers and enterprise architects to align technical solutions with investment processes.
Mentor engineering teams and establish best practices for Snowflake optimization, data security, and cloud integration.
Support AI/ML use cases by preparing high-quality data feeds for quantitative models and analytics.
Must have Skills & Experience
Total 18+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, and enterprise data management, with strong exposure to financial services/asset management.
Deep expertise in Snowflake (performance tuning, role-based access, data sharing, zero-copy cloning, materialized views, etc), Snow spark, Cortex AI SQL, Cortex Agents.
Proven ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models for investment workflows, including:
Portfolio & Risk data structures from Aladdin.
Trade/Order data models integrating OMS/EMS platforms.
Client reporting and performance attribution models.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python/Scala for building scalable data pipelines.
Strong understanding of investment management workflows (portfolio construction, risk management, performance measurement, compliance, reporting).
Experience in leading large-scale enterprise data initiatives with cross-functional stakeholders.
Desirable skills that help you excel
Prior experience with BlackRock Aladdin model customization and integration with Snowflake.
Knowledge of alternative data integration and AI-driven investment analytics.
Familiarity with visualization & BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Experience with cloud-native platforms (GCP) and enterprise integration patterns.
Performance and cost optimization in snowflake
Educational & Technical Qualification Requirements
- Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
- More than 10 years experience in enterprise architecture and full-stack development.
How we'll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

EY Technology
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

title: Techno Functional Engineer, AVP
description:
A Techno Functional Engineer is responsible for designing, developing and delivering end to end working product for the business users, based on a given broader business requirement, by applying techno functional expertise drawn from both technical and functional experience / knowledge so that to accomplish business goals efficiently and reliably.
Key responsibilities of this role include
Responsible for leading activities which details the complex requirements from Business users into system specific functional specifications.
Active participation in the design of their solution components with business, with a solution mindset
Investigating re-use, ensuring that solutions are fit for purpose, reliable, maintainable, and can be integrated successfully into the overall functional solution and environment with clear, robust and well tested deployments.
Advising businesses on investing in new technologies/solutions in alignment to the bank s architecture blueprint
Managing end to end delivery of realizing the business benefit
Actively look for opportunities to improve the availability and performance of components by applying the learning from monitoring and observation, automating towards zero touch, and championing a DevOps mind-set
Serves as a functional specialist and as the day-to-day leader of work efforts in this area within a regulatory reporting value stream(s)
What we'll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
Your key responsibilities
Uses awareness of industry initiatives to work with stakeholders to align with strategy and roadmap while supporting the development of market-driven, sustainable business, process and data architectures.
Supports the implementation of common architecture and strategies and applies Bank wide standards and best practices.
Supports the implementation of optimum architectures of technology solutions and drives analysts, designers, and engineers in technology teams to design, build, test and deliver high quality software solutions to meet business needs.
Acts as functional lead/expert for a domain, applications and technology and completes high complex functional / non-functional specification documentation and designs.
Completes and elaborates complex functional designs in accordance with the defined principles, blueprints, standards, patterns, etc
Designs and conceptualizes new complex business solution options with proof-of-concepts and articulates identified impacts and risks.
Reviews testing requirements including test plans, test cases, test-data, and interface testing between different applications. Works with engineers to resolve complex functional issues arising from integration / user acceptance testing.
Provides thought leadership in the development of new models/ techniques for delivering step change in business processes.
Defines guiding principles for designing industrialised, high STP (straight-through processing) business process solutions.
Acts as virtual supervisor for analysis and design work within a project/programme regionally.
Reviews and provides feedback on functional solutions and performs quality assurance of project deliverables.
Drives design challenges, implements key design and design building blocks, leverages design practices and insists on design patterns used by engineers.
Translates and reviews logical data design at various stages of the data journey.
Works with engineers, to priorities, trouble shoot and resolve reported bugs / issues / CRs (change requests) on applications.
Drives data discovery, sourcing, modelling, and analytics to support the creation of data flows and models. This includes researching and profiling data sources in data categories of expertise.
Plays an active and leading role in relevant Communities of Practice such as the Business Functional Analysis Community of Practice and other Design/Architecture related Communities of Practice.
Undertaking peer reviews and reviewing solution designs and architectures, taking into consideration specific business, usability and functional constraints, requirements and dependencies.

Fluent in English (written/verbal).
12+ experience in managing teams of complex sizeable global IT change projects under varying project/programme environments (waterfall, scrum/agile) and tight timelines.
Strong working Experience in interpreting multiple end to end APAC regulatory jurisdictions (such as MAS, FSA, BNM, BOK, etc) in the past 6+ years across Financial, Risk and Transactional reporting.
Experience working with business requirements through to application design.
Experience in functrional analysis, data analytics or UX (user experience).
Experience in a financial domain (capital markets, transaction banking, and wealth management) and/or related support functions.
Experience owing programme backlogs, driving programme increments and release content via prioritised features and establishing feature acceptance criteria.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving experience and ability to independently identify issues, introduce new concepts, provide innovative insights/ solutions and oversee their delivery.
High degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Strong planning and highly organised with ability to prioritize key deliverables across several work streams.
Excellent communication and documentation / presentation skills.
Self-motivated and flexibility to work autonomously coupled with ability to work in virtual teams and matrix/global organisations including appreciation of different cultures during collaborating and sharing.
Strong ability to influence and motivate other team members and stakeholders through strong dialogue, facilitation and persuasiveness.
Strong leadership and ability to advance decisions and escalations.
Profound knowledge of methods and tooling for the Business Functional Analysis Profession.
Advanced knowledge of MS Office products.

Experience of Data Taxonomy and Local Regulatory Reporting Data modelling,

Your day at NTT DATA
The Data Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for the transformation of data into a structured format that can be easily analyzed in a query or report.

This role is responsible for developing structured data sets that can be reused or complimented by other data sets and reports.

This role analyzes the data sources and data structure and designs and develops data models to support the analytics requirements of the business which includes management / operational / predictive / data science capabilities.

Key responsibilities:
Creates data models in a structured data format to enable analysis thereof.
Designs and develops scalable extract, transformation and loading (ETL) packages from the business source systems and the development of ETL routines to populate data from sources,
Participates in the transformation of object and data models into appropriate database schemas within design constraints.
Interprets installation standards to meet project needs and produce database components as required.
Creates test scenarios and be responsible for participating in thorough testing and validation to support the accuracy of data transformations.

Accountable for analysis, and development of ETL and migration documentation.
Collaborates with various stakeholders to evaluate potential data requirements.
Accountable for the definition and management of scoping, requirements, definition, and prioritization activities for small-scale changes and assist with more complex change initiatives.
Collaborates with various stakeholders, contributing to the recommendation of improvements in automated and non-automated components of the data tables, data queries and data models.

Seasoned knowledge of the definition and management of scoping requirements, definition and prioritization activities.

Corporate Title: Director

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures - but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Flexible working arrangements
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term Life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
Role Summary
DWS is seeking a Director-level Enterprise Data Engineer with 18+ years of experience in data engineering, architecture, and enterprise platforms. Deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake implementation and a strong background in data modeling within asset management domain. The ideal candidate will have designed and implemented complex investment data models, especially on Aladdin (BlackRock), and will play a strategic role in shaping our enterprise data strategy while being actively involved in hands-on engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale data models in Snowflake to support investment data, portfolio analytics, risk, and performance workflows.
Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating Aladdin data, market/reference data providers, and internal financial systems.
Build investment data models such as:
Portfolio & Holdings Model (positions, transactions, performance)
Benchmark & Index Model (tracking error, benchmark alignment, relative performance)
Risk Model (VaR, factor exposures, scenario analysis)
Compliance & Regulatory Model (pre-trade/post-trade checks, regulatory filings, client mandates)
Performance Attribution Model (security-level attribution, multi-factor attribution)
Ensure data governance, lineage, and quality frameworks are built into the data layer.
Partner with principal engineers and enterprise architects to align technical solutions with investment processes.
Mentor engineering teams and establish best practices for Snowflake optimization, data security, and cloud integration.
Support AI/ML use cases by preparing high-quality data feeds for quantitative models and analytics.
Must have Skills & Experience
Total 18+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, and enterprise data management, with strong exposure to financial services/asset management.
Deep expertise in Snowflake (performance tuning, role-based access, data sharing, zero-copy cloning, materialized views, etc), Snow spark, Cortex AI SQL, Cortex Agents.
Proven ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models for investment workflows, including:
Portfolio & Risk data structures from Aladdin.
Trade/Order data models integrating OMS/EMS platforms.
Client reporting and performance attribution models.
Advanced skills in SQL and Python/Scala for building scalable data pipelines.
Strong understanding of investment management workflows (portfolio construction, risk management, performance measurement, compliance, reporting).
Experience in leading large-scale enterprise data initiatives with cross-functional stakeholders.

Prior experience with BlackRock Aladdin model customization and integration with Snowflake.
Knowledge of alternative data integration and AI-driven investment analytics.
Familiarity with visualization & BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
Experience with cloud-native platforms (GCP) and enterprise integration patterns.
Performance and cost optimization in snowflake

- Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
- More than 10 years experience in enterprise architecture and full-stack development.

Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Hadoop EY-Advisory - Data and Analytics - Manager - Cloud Data Engineer/Architect
EYs Advisory Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY s financial services practice provides integrated advisory services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY s Advisory Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client s decision-making.
The opportunity
We re looking Senior Data Architect with 12+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or big data roles, with at least 5 years focused specifically on data architecture. The candidate will be a technical expert in the modern big data ecosystem, with proven mastery of Hadoop, Hive, Spark, and Apache Iceberg. Candidate will be responsible for defining our strategic data architecture, setting technical standards, and leading the implementation of robust, scalable, and efficient data solutions.
Your key responsibilities
Work as a project manager to Lead the design and evolution of our large-scale data lakehouse architecture, ensuring it is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineers and analysts. Collaborate closely with Software Engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
Experience in data modelling, data mapping, data profiling and meta data management.
Architect and tune high-performance data processing pipelines. Identify and resolve complex performance issues in distributed computing environments involving Spark execution, Hive query optimization, and Iceberg metadata management.
Expert Experience on Hadoop (HDFS, YARN), Hive (including LLAP, Tez), Spark (Structured Streaming, Spark SQL), and Apache Iceberg.
Expert-level proficiency in building and optimizing large-scale data processing pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala).
Deep understanding of Spark internals, execution plans, and tuning.
Extensive experience in writing, optimizing, and managing HiveQL scripts. Deep knowledge of Hive architecture, file formats (ORC, Parquet), and performance tuning.
Strong, hands-on experience with the core Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, YARN, MapReduce). Understanding of cluster management and fundamentals.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing data lakes using Apache Iceberg as the table format. Must understand features like schema evolution, hidden partitioning, time travel, and performance benefits over Hive tables.
Experience in either Python (PySpark) or Scala.
Mastery of SQL and experience optimizing complex queries on massive datasets.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS (EMR, S3, Glue), Azure (Databricks, ADLS, Synapse), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS)).
Interface and communicate with the onsite teams directly to understand the requirement and determine the optimum solutions.
Create technical solutions as per business needs by translating their requirements and finding innovative solution options.
Lead and mentor a team throughout design, development and delivery phases and keep the team intact on high pressure situations.
Get involved in business development activities like creating proof of concepts (POCs), point of views (POVs), assist in proposal writing and service offering development, and capable of developing creative power point content for presentations.
Create and maintain detailed architecture diagrams, data flow maps, and other technical documentation.
Participate in organization-level initiatives and operational activities.
Skills and attributes for success
Use an issue-based approach to deliver growth, market and portfolio strategy engagements for corporates
Strong communication, presentation and team building skills and experience in producing high quality reports, papers, and presentations.
Experience in executing and managing research and analysis of companies and markets, preferably from a commercial due diligence standpoint.
Ideally, you ll also have
8-10 years of experience in Banking and capital markets sector preferred
Cloud architect certifications
Experience using Agile methodologies.
Experience with real-time stream processing technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).
Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience with DevOps/DataOps principles and CI/CD pipelines for data projects.

title: Data Engineer II
description:
You thrive on diversity and creativity, and we welcome individuals who share our vision of making a lasting impact. Your unique combination of design thinking and experience will help us achieve new heights.


As a Data Engineer II at JPMorgan Chase within the Wealth Management division, you will be part of an agile team dedicated to enhancing, designing, and delivering data collection, storage, access, and analytics solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable manner. As an emerging member of the data engineering team, you will execute data solutions by designing, developing, and troubleshooting various components within technical products, applications, or systems, while acquiring the skills and experience necessary for growth in your role.

Job responsibilities


Supports the review of controls to ensure sufficient protection of enterprise data.

Reviews and makes customizations in one or two tools to generate a product at the businesss or customers request.

Updates logical or physical data models based on new use cases.

Frequently uses SQL and understands NoSQL databases and their niche in the marketplace.

Contributes to the teams culture by promoting collaboration and innovation.

Designs, develops, and maintains robust data pipelines to automate the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from various sources into data warehouses or data lakes.

Integrates data from multiple sources, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and reliability.

Collaborates with product owners to understand data requirements and provide solutions.

Documents data pipeline processes and workflows for future reference and training.


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills


Formal training or certification on data engineering disciplines and 2+ years applied experience

Advanced proficiency in SQL (e. g. , joins and aggregations)

Working understanding of NoSQL databases

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python/Java for data processing tasks

Proficient in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts, with a strong ability to design and implement robust, reusable, and maintainable code structures across various programming languages

Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Amazon Web Services (AWS), including EMR, Glue, Lambda, and ECS, to design, deploy, and manage scalable and efficient cloud-based solutions

Hands-on experience with frameworks like Apache Spark, leveraging its capabilities for large-scale data processing and analytics to drive efficient and insightful data solutions

Are you searching for an opportunity to play a key role in driving the dramatic growth of a highly successful software company

At Poppulo, we re working on what s next in communications and workplace technology. As a pioneer in this industry, we understand that meaningfully reaching every employee is hard. We are seeking an experienced Software Architect to join our Employee Communications Architecture team. You will lead the design and evolution of our SaaS Employee Communications platform providing multi-channel employee communications capabilities to our global customer base.

The ideal candidate brings deep SaaS expertise, hands-on experience with AWS serverless technologies, a solid understanding of distributed system design and understanding of AI technologies.

Produce, promote and govern scalable and reliable architectural patterns and standards to follow (with reference implementations)

Architect and evolve systems to ensure modularity, scalability, and performance across a multi-tenant SaaS environment.

Design and implement capabilities across our SaaS platform leading on PoCs for emerging capabilities.

Guide design decisions, Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Explore market and open-source offerings for new capabilities and lead buy versus build decisions including leading vendor and partner technical evaluations.

Why should you apply to this role
The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large-scale Cloud migrations.
You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. Drive Accountability : Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.

Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
Team Leadership : Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data-driven mindset expected of Atlassian s delivery leaders.
Industry Insight: Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
Extensive experience working in or around software delivery roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on-prem and cloud.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
Strong ability to influence customer decision-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior-level decision-makers and c-suite executives.
Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
At least 15 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
Bachelor s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

description:
About The Role  


Skill required: Insurance Services - Insurance Claims


Designation: Risk Engineering Analyst


Qualifications:BE


Years of Experience:2 to 6 years


What would you do?
Risk Engineering provides guidance on risk mitigation for multiple disciplines and occupancies. The objective is to enable global property underwriters to make more informed underwriting decisions.The team performs risk assessments of various commercial and industrial occupancies from a property insurance loss prevention perspective in support of global Account Engineers and Underwriters.The types of risk include a large variety of occupancies like commercial and residential real estate, hospitals, hotels, IT parks, shopping and other service-oriented occupancies as well as all industrial manufacturing occupancies.Insurance is a legal agreement between two parties the insurer and the insured, also known as insurance coverage or insurance policy. title: Associate Product Manager (Data & Analytics Focus)
description:
Job Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented and ambitious Associate Product Manager to take product ownership of Starweaver Analytics under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager.
While the Senior PM drives the overarching strategy for our enterprise ecosystem, you will be the specialist focusing on our data product. You will be responsible for transforming raw learning and behavioral data into actionable insights, dashboards, and visualization features for our customers (Enterprises, Instructors, and Admins).
This role is not for a fresher. We need someone with 2-3 years of experience who understands how data products are built, who loves digging into Google Analytics/Tableau/Mixpanel to understand user behavior, and who can translate complex data requirements into clear user stories for engineering and design teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Audit & Platform Optimization (Gap Analysis)
Audit & Benchmarking: Conduct a rigorous audit of the existing Starweaver Analytics platform to uncover gaps in functionality, data inconsistencies, and usability flaws.
Revamp Existing Flows: actively identify and refactor inefficient user workflows. You will look at legacy features with a fresh pair of eyes and propose optimizations to reduce friction, improve load times, and enhance data readability.
Continuous Improvement: Establish a cycle of analyzing production data to spot underperforming features, prioritizing fixes that yield the highest value for the least technical debt.
2. Technical Specifications & Requirements Engineering
Bridge Business & Tech: Act as the primary translator between the "what" (Business goals/Senior PM vision) and the "how" (Engineering execution).
Constraint Management: Deeply understand the underlying data architecture and technical constraints. You must proactively discuss feasibility with engineers before finalizing specs to avoid designing solutions that are impossible or too costly to build.
Robust Documentation: Write detailed JIRA stories and PRDs (Product Requirements Documents) that include happy paths, edge cases, error states, and data validation logic to leave zero ambiguity for developers.
3. Product Ownership & Roadmap Execution
Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to maintain the backlog for the Analytics platform.
Prioritize tickets based on a mix of new feature requests, bug fixes, and necessary refactoring of existing code.
Ensure that Starweaver Analytics aligns with the broader ecosystem (Boostr, JourneyBuilder) by standardizing how data is shared and visualized across platforms.
4. Quality Assurance (QA) & Data Validation
The "Final Gatekeeper": Take full ownership of User Acceptance Testing (UAT). You are responsible for signing off on releases, ensuring that what was built matches what was specified.
Data Accuracy Testing: Specifically for our Analytics product, you must rigorously test data reports against the raw database. You will ensure calculations, aggregations, and visualizations are 100% accurate before they reach the client.
Regression Monitoring: Keep a pulse on existing functionality to ensure that new code commits do not break previously working flows.
5. Data Analysis & Insight Generation
Act as the "Power User" of internal analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, internal logs).
Analyze user behavior not just to report on it, but to understand how users are struggling with the current platform, using that data to justify product improvements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Product Delivery: Maintain a consistent sprint velocity with >90% of committed user stories delivered per cycle.
Data Integrity: Achieve near zero bugs regarding data accuracy in production reports.
Feature Adoption: Drive measurable engagement usage of the Analytics Dashboards by enterprise clients.
Stakeholder Satisfaction: High feedback ratings from the Engineering and Design teams regarding the clarity of requirements and JIRA tickets.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Business, or related field.
Experience
2 to 3 years of relevant product management or business analysis experience (No freshers).
Proven track record of optimizing existing products: Must demonstrate experience where you analyzed a live product, identified flaws, and executed a plan to improve it (not just building 0-to-1 features).
Experience working closely with engineering teams to dissect technical limitations and find workarounds.
Experience writing test cases for complex, data-driven applications.
Technical Skills
Data Fluency: Strong familiarity with Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
SQL Knowledge: Ability to run basic SQL queries to validate if the data shown in the UI matches the database is highly desirable.
Specification Tools: Mastery of JIRA/Confluence for documenting edge cases and technical requirements.
Core Competencies
Analytical Thinking: You rely on data, not gut feeling, to make decisions. You enjoy finding patterns in numbers.
Detail-Oriented: In data products, precision is everything. You spot inconsistencies that others miss.
Structured Communication: Ability to break down complex data problems into simple language for developers and designers.
Ownership: You are a self-starter who can take a vague requirement like "We need better reporting" and turn it into a concrete feature set.
Agile: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and can adapt to multiple requirements at a given time. Experience in startups is preferred.
Benefits
Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
Opportunity to be the product owner of a high-impact analytics platform.
Access to a global network of educators, designers, and technology experts.
Opportunity to contribute to innovative educational technology solutions.
How to Apply:
Please submit your resume and a brief note highlighting a data-driven feature or product you helped build or improve.

The salary for this job is based on experience, so whilst we are not able to go into detail at this stage, we can say that we offer great salary packages and a discretionary annual performance bonus. We can also provide advice and dedicated assistance to those moving to Leeds.

title: Associate Product Manager (Data & Analytics Focus)
description:
Job Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented and ambitious Associate Product Manager to take product ownership of Starweaver Analytics under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager.
While the Senior PM drives the overarching strategy for our enterprise ecosystem, you will be the specialist focusing on our data product. You will be responsible for transforming raw learning and behavioral data into actionable insights, dashboards, and visualization features for our customers (Enterprises, Instructors, and Admins).
This role is not for a fresher. We need someone with 2-3 years of experience who understands how data products are built, who loves digging into Google Analytics/Tableau/Mixpanel to understand user behavior, and who can translate complex data requirements into clear user stories for engineering and design teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Audit & Platform Optimization (Gap Analysis)
Audit & Benchmarking: Conduct a rigorous audit of the existing Starweaver Analytics platform to uncover gaps in functionality, data inconsistencies, and usability flaws.
Revamp Existing Flows: actively identify and refactor inefficient user workflows. You will look at legacy features with a fresh pair of eyes and propose optimizations to reduce friction, improve load times, and enhance data readability.
Continuous Improvement: Establish a cycle of analyzing production data to spot underperforming features, prioritizing fixes that yield the highest value for the least technical debt.
2. Technical Specifications & Requirements Engineering
Bridge Business & Tech: Act as the primary translator between the "what" (Business goals/Senior PM vision) and the "how" (Engineering execution).
Constraint Management: Deeply understand the underlying data architecture and technical constraints. You must proactively discuss feasibility with engineers before finalizing specs to avoid designing solutions that are impossible or too costly to build.
Robust Documentation: Write detailed JIRA stories and PRDs (Product Requirements Documents) that include happy paths, edge cases, error states, and data validation logic to leave zero ambiguity for developers.
3. Product Ownership & Roadmap Execution
Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to maintain the backlog for the Analytics platform.
Prioritize tickets based on a mix of new feature requests, bug fixes, and necessary refactoring of existing code.
Ensure that Starweaver Analytics aligns with the broader ecosystem (Boostr, JourneyBuilder) by standardizing how data is shared and visualized across platforms.
4. Quality Assurance (QA) & Data Validation
The "Final Gatekeeper": Take full ownership of User Acceptance Testing (UAT). You are responsible for signing off on releases, ensuring that what was built matches what was specified.
Data Accuracy Testing: Specifically for our Analytics product, you must rigorously test data reports against the raw database. You will ensure calculations, aggregations, and visualizations are 100% accurate before they reach the client.
Regression Monitoring: Keep a pulse on existing functionality to ensure that new code commits do not break previously working flows.
5. Data Analysis & Insight Generation
Act as the "Power User" of internal analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, internal logs).
Analyze user behavior not just to report on it, but to understand how users are struggling with the current platform, using that data to justify product improvements.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Product Delivery: Maintain a consistent sprint velocity with >90% of committed user stories delivered per cycle.
Data Integrity: Achieve near zero bugs regarding data accuracy in production reports.
Feature Adoption: Drive measurable engagement usage of the Analytics Dashboards by enterprise clients.
Stakeholder Satisfaction: High feedback ratings from the Engineering and Design teams regarding the clarity of requirements and JIRA tickets.
Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Business, or related field.
Experience
2 to 3 years of relevant product management or business analysis experience (No freshers).
Proven track record of optimizing existing products: Must demonstrate experience where you analyzed a live product, identified flaws, and executed a plan to improve it (not just building 0-to-1 features).
Experience working closely with engineering teams to dissect technical limitations and find workarounds.
Experience writing test cases for complex, data-driven applications.
Technical Skills
Data Fluency: Strong familiarity with Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
SQL Knowledge: Ability to run basic SQL queries to validate if the data shown in the UI matches the database is highly desirable.
Specification Tools: Mastery of JIRA/Confluence for documenting edge cases and technical requirements.
Core Competencies
Analytical Thinking: You rely on data, not gut feeling, to make decisions. You enjoy finding patterns in numbers.
Detail-Oriented: In data products, precision is everything. You spot inconsistencies that others miss.
Structured Communication: Ability to break down complex data problems into simple language for developers and designers.
Ownership: You are a self-starter who can take a vague requirement like "We need better reporting" and turn it into a concrete feature set.
Agile: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and can adapt to multiple requirements at a given time. Experience in startups is preferred.

Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

Work you ll do
Your role
As an Associate Director in our team you ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations: -
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager who would lead end-to-end delivery of CRD VI / CRR III regulatory change projects. The role focuses on project governance, credit risk regulatory implementation, data remediation , and coordination across Risk, Finance, and Technology teams. The position requires strong understanding of Basel III reforms , credit risk processes, regulatory reporting, and banking data architecture .
Key Responsibilities:
Project Planning & Governance - Manage end-to-end project planning, scope definition, and timeline tracking for CRD VI / CRR III regulatory initiatives. Maintain strong governance through RAID management, milestone reporting, and adherence to PMO standards.
Regulatory Impact & Requirement Analysis - Interpret CRD VI regulatory changes and convert them into clear business and technical requirements. Conduct impact assessments to identify process, data, and system changes needed for regulatory compliance.
Requirements Documentation & Traceability - Prepare BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Ensure requirements are properly documented, traceable, and aligned with regulatory expectations.
Data & System Remediation Delivery - Oversee data sourcing, data quality remediation, and system updates required for new capital and RWA calculations. Coordinate with IT, data teams, and risk SMEs to ensure changes meet BCBS 239 and CRR III standards.
SIT/UAT Testing Management - Define testing strategy, develop test cases, and manage SIT/UAT execution across functional teams. Ensure defect resolution, requirement traceability, and obtain signoffs to support deployment readiness.
Cross-Functional Stakeholder Coordination - Work closely with Risk, Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Technology, and Model teams to align deliverables. Lead meetings, workshops, and governance forums to resolve dependencies and keep workstreams on track.
Status Reporting & Management Updates - Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and updates for senior management and steering committees. Highlight risks, issues, and mitigation plans to ensure informed decision-making.
Compliance, Controls & Audit Support - Ensure project activities align with compliance requirements, control frameworks, and regulatory standards. Support internal and external audits by providing documentation, evidence, and responses.
Go-Live Readiness & Post-Implementation Support - Manage deployment planning, cutover activities, and coordination with business and technology teams. Provide post-go-live support, monitor issues, and ensure a stable transition to BAU operations.
Skills & Experience Required:
Strong knowledge of CRD VI, CRR III, Basel III, Pillar 1 & Pillar 2, RWA calculations, and credit risk parameters (PD, LGD, EAD).
Experience with regulatory reporting frameworks such as COREP, FINREP, and risk data aggregation standards (BCBS 239).
Hands-on experience in data migration, data sourcing, data lineage, data quality remediation, and data governance.
Solid understanding of credit risk processes, ICAAP, model governance, and capital adequacy requirements.
Expertise in preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing requirement traceability.
Strong knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies, project governance, RAID management, and delivery oversight.
Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and PMO reporting tools.
Excellent analytical skills, stakeholder management capabilities, and cross-functional coordination experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in finance, Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Advanced qualifications preferred: MBA, CFA, FRM, PRM, PMP, or Prince2.
Experience in Tier-1 banks, consulting firms, or regulatory transformation projects.
Familiarity with ICAAP submissions, supervisory reviews, and internal/external audit interactions.
Exposure to large-scale data remediation, risk model implementation, or regulatory reporting change projects.
